content: In this evaluation, we used Mean Average Precision (MAP) and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) which are commonly used in QA to evaluate the top-10 answers for each question. We consider answers rated as “Correct and Complete Answer” or “Correct but Incomplete” as correct answers, as the test questions contain multiple subquestions while each answer in our QA collection can cover only one subquestion.
